# RadiationConfig

`jaff.physics.photo_reactions.config.RadiationConfig`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Radiation field (`[network.radiation]`); the table enables radiation.

Only the shape of the settings is checked here; whether the band-averaged
spectrum converges is checked by the radiation field itself.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bands` | `list of (float or "inf")` | Increasing photon-energy band edges in eV, at least two; `"inf"` is allowed as the last edge only. |
| `profile_index` | `float or list of float` | Spectral index *α* of the photon-number spectrum `n(E) ∝ E^(α-2)`: one for every band, or a list with one per band. |
| `mode` | `str` | Tracked quantity: `"nph"` (photon number density) or `"u"` (energy density). |
| `c` | `float or str` | Speed of light in cm/s, or a symbol name (e.g. `"c_hat"`) for a reduced speed of light. |
| `background_field` | `str` | Reference radiation field used to scale `chi_pe`. |
| `absorption_attenuates_flux` | `bool` | Whether the `globalAbsorptionCoefficient` also attenuates the flux equations, not only the density equations. |
